footer.tagline: Trusted Education and Migration Agent. We plan and support your Australian education from first step to permanent residency.

hero.title: Your path to an *Australian* education, planned end to end.
hero.body: Faith Education is a trusted education and migration agent. We give you the best solution for your needs, from choosing the right college to settling into life and work in Australia.

stats.label: Years of senior leadership experience in our team

pathways.title: Four stages. *One partner* beside you.
pathways.intro: Education is the foundation of a knowledge-based society, and we have deep faith in Australia's well-structured education system. That is why we support you from the very beginning to the very end, and we call it 360-degree support.

items.title: Vocational
items.body: We shortlist ten of Australia's best business colleges and recommend the right fit. Entry needs only Year 12 completion and an IELTS score of 5.5.

items.title: Bachelor
items.body: Five carefully chosen colleges and universities where you can continue your studies, selected with close attention to both price and quality.

items.title: Masters & above
items.body: Five universities chosen for postgraduate study, with preparation for permanent residency running in parallel, so you step into the real-world job market ready.

items.title: Work & migration
items.body: Suggestions and support for work pathways and wider migration consultancy, handled by a registered migration consultant.

services.title: Two services, one *trusted* team.

items.title: Student agent
items.short: Our consultants help you plan your study, choose your college and handle everything that comes with being a student.
items.long: Faith Education consultants help you plan your study, choose your college and deal with all student-related matters, from the first conversation to graduation and beyond.

items.title: Migration agent
items.short: We help anyone who is interested in Australian visas, with the best and most up-to-date information for your application.
items.long: We help anyone interested in Australian visas. Our consultants give you the best information for applying for a visa in Australia, and review every document with care.

services.pageIntro: Whether you are choosing a first course or planning permanent residency, our consultants guide you through every decision.

benefits.title: Why students choose Faith
benefits.pageTitle: What's included, every step of the way

items.title: 360-degree support
items.body: We look after every need with a step-by-step service that takes you to the outcome you want.

items.title: Transparent service
items.body: Feedback and surveys give you visibility and accountability at every level.

items.title: Airport pick-up & accommodation
items.body: We meet you on arrival and help arrange accommodation, if you need it.

items.title: Welcome gift bag
items.body: Practical tips for Australian life, tax, superannuation and health insurance forms, plus key job links and phone numbers.

items.title: First-week essentials
items.body: A $20 phone card for your first week, and food and refreshments on your first day.

items.title: Ongoing support
items.body: We liaise with your institution on urgent needs, suggest jobs and roles, and keep you updated on legislation changes.

team.title: Experienced, qualified, *invested in you.*
team.pageIntro: Academics, counsellors and migration specialists united by one belief: the right guidance changes a life.

donar-firman-rochmilijar.bio: Donar was a university lecturer in Jakarta for 10 years and earned the academic rank of Lektor Madya (Senior Lecturer) from the Indonesian Department of Education. After his Sarjana Ekonomi at Universitas Krisnadwipaya, he studied in Australia: Graduate Diploma in Administration (University of Canberra), Master of Management Studies (UNSW) and MBA (Charles Sturt University). He began his Doctor of Business Administration at Newcastle University in 2012, and holds advanced diplomas in leadership, management and marketing, plus qualifications in education and training and project management.

liny-suryati.role: General Manager & Qualified Education Agent Counsellor
liny-suryati.bio: Liny is a Qualified Education Agent Counsellor (QEAC certified) and is well known by Australian colleges and universities for her skill in organising and preparing student visas. She understands both student needs and institutional policies, and has a very high visa approval rate. Students and their parents love her.

ares-pasaribu.bio: Ares holds a Sarjana Ekonomi in Finance from STEKPI Jakarta and a Master of Finance from Curtin University, Perth. A banker in Jakarta for over five years and an insurance professional for five more, he has taught and counselled in Australia for more than ten years, and is well known in Indonesian Christian communities in Australia and Indonesia.

eddy-widjaja.bio: Eddy has spent around twenty-five years at senior management level with industry leaders across Asia Pacific, and joined Faith Education in October 2015. Since 2010 he has also taught at Western Sydney University, Torrens University and TAFE. He is passionate about building people through education and training.

ravi-s.bio: Ravi is a registered migration consultant who looks after all visa application paperwork for Faith Education, reviewing every document with care. With long experience in migration consultancy and a director role at OZSEA, he has been part of the Faith family from the beginning.
